Title: Rotate signing keys quarterly
Description: Automate quarterly rotation of the JWT signing keys with a grace window.

Title: Add multi-item discounts to checkout totals
Description: Customers buying three or more items should receive the tiered discount. Acceptance: checkout totals reflect the discount bands.

Title: Template editor for notification e-mails
Description: Allow Comms to edit notification e-mail templates without a deploy.

Title: Nightly stock reconciliation job
Description: Reconcile warehouse stock counts against the ledger every night.

Title: Payments CI failing: database connection timeout
Description: The integration suite fails with TimeoutError: connection to payments-db timed out after 30s. Mitigated by raising the client pool timeout (PR-198).

Title: Harden payments-db client against slow connections
Description: Follow-up to DEVEX-187: add retry with exponential backoff to the payments-db client so transient slowness does not fail the pipeline.

Title: One-click reorder from order history
Description: Let a customer reorder a previous basket in one click.

Title: Audit log for admin logins
Description: Record every admin login with source address and outcome.

Title: search-index replica unreachable during CI
Description: Integration runs intermittently fail with ConnectionResetError: search-index replica unreachable. Suspected replica eviction under memory pressure; investigating.
